name: SOUL CURRENTS 2133
author: bradstestaccount
description:
Lego ID = mebradhen 

Soul Currents 2133 is an epic 20 min long underwater adventure packed with a range of content. Around some remote islands in the Atlantic, a team of explorers are searching the seafloor for lost treasure and life. You join the crew in their day to day activities, in keeping equipment operational.


CONTROLS
Simple controls! To move the submarine use WASD. If you would like it to move up and down use the Left and Right buttons on your Mouse. As you explore the ocean you will find objects you can interact with, in this case, use the button E... USE HEADPHONES!


WHY?
I wanted to make a game with a fantastic atmosphere that really pushed the LEGO Microgame sandbox. At the same time, I wanted to make something that relished and celebrated some Lego themes. This Is the finished version of the original Soul Currents I posted over a month ago. But so much has changed I wanted to submit it as its own new game. With new art, videos and description.
